title: Shifting workforce to the service sector
body: In the normal course of development, countries first shift their employment and output from agriculture to industry and then to services. China has followed this path, while in India and Pakistan the shift is taking place directly from agriculture to services. In 2022 the service sector contributed 54 per cent of GVA in India, 54 per cent in China and 55 per cent in Pakistan. Looking at the workforce, in the 1980s India, China and Pakistan employed 17, 12 and 27 per cent of their workforce in the service sector respectively. By 2022 these shares had reached 31, 45 and 38 per cent respectively. In all three countries the service sector has emerged both as the largest contributor to output and as a prospective employer.
